items.title: Jimmy Heath interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, September 8, 2014
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and I’m at St. Peter’s Church inside the chapel with Mr. Jimmy Heath... [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you very much, Monk.

ctx.x: Jimmy was interviewed in New York City on September 8, 2014, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m at St. Peter’s Church inside the chapel with Mr. Jimmy Heath, composer and arranger, jazz master. I wanted to congratulate you on your career —
